rawInci: Ingredients: Aqua, Lauryl Glucoside, Coco-Glucoside, Sodium Coco-Sulfate, Sucrose, Glycerin, Sodium Chloride, Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein, Tocopherol, Ascorbyl Palmitate, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis Seed Extract, Parfum, Sorbitol, Glyceryl Oleate, Sodium Levulinate, Inulin, Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate, Lecithin, Levulinic Acid, p-Anisic Acid, Benzoic Acid, Citric Acid, Sodium Hydroxide, Vanillin

propertyRationales.cleansingStrength: Glucosides lead the surfactant system with Sodium Coco-Sulfate as an efficient anionic cleanser, supporting moderate cleansing with possible upper-moderate strength.
propertyRationales.conditioningLevel: Glyceryl Oleate, lecithin and hydrolyzed wheat protein support light-to-moderate refatting and surface feel, but there is no cationic polymer or silicone deposition bridge.
propertyRationales.weightPotential: Several weak-to-moderate refatting/film signals may leave light residue, but no substantive silicone or cationic polymer route is present.
propertyRationales.focusPrimary: Formula signals are balanced between cleansing, mildness potential and light conditioning, so blind formula-only classification stays general.
propertyRationales.focusSecondary: No distinct claim-led secondary role is available, and v1.4 defaults secondary focus to empty.
propertyRationales.usageRole: No explicit frequent-use, reset or treatment trigger is available, so usage remains regular.
propertyRationales.scalpComfortTarget: Glucoside-led cleansing and refatting/humectant support suggest comfort-leaning potential, but fragrance and no tolerance testing leave scalp-comfort targeting unknown rather than established.
propertyRationales.dandruffSupport: The complete formula does not list Piroctone Olamine or Climbazole.

formulaObservations: Lauryl Glucoside and Coco-Glucoside precede Sodium Coco-Sulfate.
Sucrose, Glycerin and Sorbitol create a notable humectant/sugar matrix.
Glyceryl Oleate, lecithin and hydrogenated palm glycerides citrate provide refatting or lipid-like support.
Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein and Inulin provide weak film/body support.
No cationic polymer, silicone, chelator or recognized anti-dandruff active is listed.
counterSignals: Sodium Coco-Sulfate can still contribute meaningful detergency; sulfate-free-style architecture is not automatically mild.
Protein without a cationic/deposition aid is capped as weak film support.
Citric and other acids do not establish finished acidic pH from INCI alone.
Botanical extract and antioxidants are not primary performance mechanisms.

finalDelta.reason: Nutri-Care und strapaziertes Haar wählen Repair/Pflege als Fokus; die Formel stützt das nur als temporäre kosmetische Oberfläche über Protein und Refatting.
Die unblindeten Claims nennen strapaziertes Haar, nicht Kopfhautkomfort; deshalb wird das vorherige unknown zu not_targeted, ohne eine Ungeeignetheit abzuleiten.

focusPrimary.formulaRoute: Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein plus Glyceryl Oleate/Lecithin/Inulin stützen leichte temporäre Pflege für strapaziertes Haar.
focusPrimary.decisionReason: Die unblindete Nutri-Care-/strapaziertes-Haar-Positionierung ist dominant; die Formel ist schwach bis moderat kompatibel.

usageRole.rationale: Reguläres Rinse-off-Shampoo ohne Frequent-, Reset- oder Treatment-Trigger.

formulaRoutes.evidence: Glyceryl Oleate, Lecithin und Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate sind leichte Refatting-Signale.
Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein und Inulin geben leichten Film-/Body-Support.
Sucrose, Glycerin und Sorbitol erhöhen Feuchtigkeits-/Rückstandsgefühl nur leicht.

competingSignals: No cationic polymer, silicone, or rich oil bridge.
